review.description: Credential acquisition, local owner consent, encryption and public projection boundaries keep their existing meanings. New review journals/captures remain private application data and bounded workers receive individual session capture paths. S5 preserves explicit full-access command authority against ambient read-only configuration while retaining bounded-profile permissions and existing credential/environment boundaries. Explicit bounded command reviewers now receive the already supported nested native context with empty profile skills. The stale UI gap now acknowledges implemented engine capabilities while preserving live-provider/host/publication acceptance gaps.
review.implementation: Reviewed model child configuration disabling ambient MCP/apps and native command environment preservation; engine origin metadata stores identity digests and artifact references rather than credentials. No owner configuration or credential material enters Git. Inspected command/exec params: a per-command full-access override is attached only for the selected full-access profile. Bounded modes keep their named policy; allowed attempt metadata and private environment filtering remain unchanged. Reviewed taskSandboxWithNativeChild explicit option from reviewModelWorkers.command; it reuses the existing packaged-skill branch without fake skills or duplicated auth/inventory/shim setup. Normal/model callers remain on their prior selection gate and full access retains its prior early return.
review.tests: Read credential-form assertions rejecting cross-origin and wrong nonce requests, preventing secret echo, accepting exactly one concurrent save and rejecting expiry. Default-worker fixtures inspect permissions/environment arguments with fake credentials only. Read the three-profile command protocol regression assertions for actual child stdin/XDG/TMPDIR, allowed attempt metadata, dropped untrusted environment and no request PATH override. Bounded selections must retain workspace read/write permissions without a sandboxPolicy override; fixture results do not establish native OS enforcement. Read TestProductionCommandWithoutSkillsRetainsNativeContext: a fail-closed private-PATH guard precedes fixture nested invocation; dummy auth/config references, retained inventory, connector/app overrides, native read-only context and root-deny/private-sibling/selected-mode/environment/stdin assertions are checked for empty-skill read-only and workspace-write commands. Synthetic kernel flags only exercise the shim guard and do not establish OS sandbox enforcement.
